shellCommands.command: for f in /workspace/pages/404.js /workspace/pages/_app.js /workspace/pages/_document.js /workspace/pages/_error.js /workspace/pages/index.js /workspace/pages/blog/index.js /workspace/pages/blog/[id].js /workspace/components/AppProvider.js; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat "$f"; done; echo "=== api ==="; find /workspace/pages/api -type f
cat "/workspace/pages/api/posts/index.js" "/workspace/pages/api/posts/[id].js"; echo "=== next.config ==="; cat /workspace/next.config.ts; echo "=== tsconfig ==="; cat /workspace/tsconfig.json

sed -n 120,260p /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/caching-without-cache-components.md; echo "====== SEGMENT CONFIG INDEX ======"; cat /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/02-route-segment-config/index.md

sed -n 1,80p /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/18-upgrading.md; echo "==== generateMetadata sig ===="; grep -n -A20 "generateMetadata(" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/generate-metadata.md | head -60

(npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/next-start.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 4 && echo "--- / ---" && curl -s http://localhost:3123/ | grep -o "<title>[^<]*</title>\|Welcome to My Blog\|Your user agent: [^<]*" | head -5

echo "--- /blog ---" && curl -s http://localhost:3123/blog | grep -o "<title>[^<]*</title>" | head -1
echo "--- /blog/3 ---" && curl -s http://localhost:3123/blog/3 | grep -o "<title>[^<]*</title>\|Comments (" | head -3
echo "--- /blog/9999 (notFound) ---" && curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3123/blog/9999
echo "--- /nonexistent (404 page) ---" && curl -s -w "\nHTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3123/nonexistent | grep -o "404 - Page Not Found\|HTTP [0-9]*"
echo "--- GET /api/posts ---" && curl -s http://localhost:3123/api/posts
echo "--- POST /api/posts (valid) ---" && curl -s -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"title":"t","content":"c"}' -w " [%{http_code}]" http://localhost:3123/api/posts
echo; echo "--- POST /api/posts (invalid) ---" && curl -s -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{}' -w " [%{http_code}]" http://localhost:3123/api/posts
echo; echo "--- PUT /api/posts/7 ---" && curl -s -X PUT -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"title":"x"}' http://localhost:3123/api/posts/7
echo "--- DELETE /api/posts/7 ---" && curl -s -X DELETE http://localhost:3123/api/posts/7
echo "--- PATCH /api/posts (405) ---" && curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} allow=%header{allow}\n" -X PATCH http://localhost:3123/api/posts

curl -s http://localhost:3123/blog/9999 | grep -c "404 - Page Not Found"; curl -s http://localhost:3123/blog/9999 | grep -o "Go Back Home" | head -1; kill %1 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; git -C /workspace status --short
git -C /workspace status --short; echo; git -C /workspace diff --stat -- tsconfig.json
